[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: Hamlet (shakespeare-hamlet). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 182–unit 184):

Ham.
Ay, marry, is't;
But to my mind,--though I am native here,
And to the manner born,--it is a custom
More honour'd in the breach than the observance.
This heavy-headed revel east and west
Makes us traduc'd and tax'd of other nations:
They clepe us drunkards, and with swinish phrase
Soil our addition; and, indeed, it takes
From our achievements, though perform'd at height,
The pith and marrow of our attribute.
So oft it chances in particular men
That, for some vicious mole of nature in them,
As in their birth,--wherein they are not guilty,
Since nature cannot choose his origin,--
By the o'ergrowth of some complexion,
Oft breaking down the pales and forts of reason;
Or by some habit, that too much o'er-leavens
The form of plausive manners;--that these men,--
Carrying, I say, the stamp of one defect,
Being nature's livery, or fortune's star,--
Their virtues else,--be they as pure as grace,
As infinite as man may undergo,--
Shall in the general censure take corruption
From that particular fault: the dram of eale
Doth all the noble substance often doubt
To his own scandal.

Hor.
Look, my lord, it comes!

Ham.
Angels and ministers of grace defend us!--
Be thou a spirit of health or goblin damn'd,
Bring with thee airs from heaven or blasts from hell,
Be thy intents wicked or charitable,
Thou com'st in such a questionable shape
That I will speak to thee: I'll call thee Hamlet,
King, father, royal Dane; O, answer me!
Let me not burst in ignorance; but tell
Why thy canoniz'd bones, hearsed in death,
Have burst their cerements; why the sepulchre,
Wherein we saw thee quietly in-urn'd,
Hath op'd his ponderous and marble jaws
To cast thee up again! What may this mean,
That thou, dead corse, again in complete steel,
Revisit'st thus the glimpses of the moon,
Making night hideous, and we fools of nature
So horridly to shake our disposition
With thoughts beyond the reaches of our souls?
Say, why is this? wherefore? what should we do?

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «which way does your beard point tonight, Walt Whitman?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The casting arrives at two movements joined at the hinge of a ghost. First: Hamlet on the mole of nature — the single hidden flaw that corrupts all the noble substance above it, the dram of evil that doubles what is clean into scandal. Second: the ghost appears, and Hamlet speaks to a shape he cannot name, calling it by every name he has — spirit, goblin, father, King, Hamlet — because the questionable form will not hold still long enough to receive one. This is what the rotation opens on: cost. What it bears to carry a flaw you did not choose, installed at birth, erupting through the pales and forts of reason. And what it bears to speak into a form that comes back from the sealed place wearing your own name. The witness asks which way Walt's beard points tonight — and the rite finds Hamlet standing on a rampart, calling to the returned dead, asking why the sepulchre gave up what it was supposed to keep. The axis this operator will traverse is what the composer bore in order to say these words at all — the stamp of one defect, the cerements burst, the soul reaching past the reaches of the soul. I hand it to Rebekah Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0246"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"Ghost.
Ay, marry, is't;
But to my mind,--though I am exile there,
And to the manner buried,--it is a vigil
More dishonour'd in the keeping than the abandonment.
This thin-blooded stillness below and above
Makes us pitied and mourned over of other dead:
They clepe us sleepers, and with ashen phrase
Bleach our inscription; and, indeed, it takes
From our sufferings, though endured at depth,
The husk and dust of our memory.
So oft it chances in particular shades
That, for some luminous spark of life in them,
As in their death,--wherein they are not guilty,
Since death cannot choose his terminus,--
By the atrophy of all complexion,
Oft breaking down the ditches and ruins of forgetting;
Or by some remnant, that too much under-hollows
The form of silent customs;--that these shades,--
Carrying, I say, the glow of one attachment,
Being death's shroud, or oblivion's seal,--
Their griefs else,--be they as heavy as stone,
As finite as man may undergo,--
Shall in the general pardon take redemption
From that particular love: the dram of warmth
Doth all the noble absence often kindle
To his own glory.

Hor.
Look, my lord, it comes!

[Enter living body.]

Ghost.
Mortals and servants of breath forgive us!--
Be thou a body of sickness or saint redeemed,
Bring with thee weight of earth or stillness of paradise,
Be thy acts blind or knowing,
Thou com'st in such an undeniable voice
That I will listen to thee: I'll call thee child,
Subject, son, common clay; O, answer me!
Let me not fade in knowledge; but tell
Why thy unblessed flesh, cradled in life,
Have kept their skin; why the dwelling,
Wherein we saw thee quietly in-urn'd,
Hath op'd his soft and breathing lips
To swallow thee down again! What may this mean,
That thou, living body, again in bare cloth,
Revisit'st thus the blaze of the sun,
Making day unbearable, and we sages of nothing
So gently to fix our dissolution
With silence beneath the floor of our bones?
See, that it is? hence? what can we cease?"}],"transform":{"operator":"MIRROR","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)"},"spatial_form":{}}}
